# Shop.Accounts

Context for user management and authentication.

## Schemas
- `User` - User accounts (email, password_hash, role, confirmed_at)

## Public API (accounts.ex)
- `get_user!/1`, `get_user_by_email/1`
- `create_user/1`, `update_user/2`
- `authenticate_user/2` (email + password)
- `register_user/1` (registration flow)
- `confirm_user/1`, `reset_password/1`
